message: I remember one evening when a storm knocked out the power just as I was settling in to binge my favorite show. My phone battery was low, and I realized I hadn’t charged my portable power bank. Talk about a tech fail! I ended up dusting off my trusty flashlight and enjoying a cozy evening with a good book instead. It was a nice reminder to keep my devices charged and ready for unexpected moments. What do you do to stay comfortable during a blackout?
